summary: This is an 8-K filed by Quantum Cyber N.V. reporting an intellectual property license agreement with Project LightShift for quantum antenna technology in defense drones. The deal involves $1M cash and $5M in restricted shares, with a prototype milestone by December 2026 and a right of first negotiation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is described. This is a routine current report on a material definitive agreement that does not qualify as a special situation.
